environment: macOS, isolated synthetic fixture, monochrome theme; sandbox enforced

runs.purpose: update footer and wide/small toolbar layout

update_dialog.latest: Observed only 前往 GitHub and 完成; 暂不更新 and log expand/collapse buttons absent; content and footer visible.
update_dialog.available: Observed 暂不更新, 前往 GitHub and 立即更新; log expand/collapse buttons absent; release text and footer visible without clipping.
update_dialog.scope: These two synthetic states were inspected; real download, installation and external links were not exercised.

toolbar.wide: Language, autostart feedback and restore feedback appeared immediately beneath their own controls, approximately 4 logical pixels apart, within the window. Skin menu remained beneath its control.
toolbar.small: At 1100×700, language and autostart feedback remained beneath their controls and within the window. Clicking restore immediately reset the window to 1440×900, where its feedback appeared beneath the control; an open restore popup at unchanged 1100×700 was therefore not observed.
toolbar.synthetic_autostart: Toggled on and off in v2; v3 was toggled on for the targeted hover check. Fixture controller only; no system login item was exercised.
toolbar.initial_issue: In v2, the language button tooltip appeared over part of the language popup close control while hovered.
toolbar.fix_retest: In v3, pointer left over language, autostart and restore buttons for approximately 1.8 seconds after opening each popup; no tooltip covered the popup and each close control remained visible.

screenshots.note: Pointer held over language button after opening; no tooltip overlap.

limits: GUI observations used synthetic fixture data only; update states and small-window layout were not repeated on v3 because the final change targeted tooltips. No real user configuration, external browser, download or installation was used.
